trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: Coral avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Coral makes two Hoof attacks and uses Tail Thump.

action.name: Hoof
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}12 ({@dégât 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoningdgts.

action.name: Tail Thump
entries: Coral slams her tail down, unleashing a burst of magical force toward une créature she can see within 60 mètres of her. The target doit faire a {@dd 16}Dextérité saving throw. On a failed save, la cible takes 22 ({@dégât 4d10}) forcedgts and has the {@condition à terre} condition. On a successful save, la cible takes half as muchdgts only. If thisdgts reduces la cible to 0touché points, la cible dies, and its body is reduced to fine dust.

bonus.name: Bubbles of Whimsy (2/Day)
entries: Coral produces a stream of magical bubbles from her horn. These bubbles float toward a creature Coral can see within 60 feet of herself. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine the bubbles' effect:

items.name: 1-2: Bolstering Treat
entries: The bubbles transform into {@dice 1d4} cookies that appear in the target's space. The target gains 11 ({@dice 2d8 + 2}) temporary hit points if it immediately uses its reaction to eat one of the cookies. Any leftover cookies are delicious but confer no benefits.

items.name: 3-4: Sparkle Burst
entries: The bubbles transform into glitter that swirls around the target before bursting outward. Each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition blinded} condition until the start of Coral's next turn.

items.name: 5-6: Stink Bomb Shield
entries: The bubbles transform into a foul-smelling cloud of gas that surrounds and shields the target. The target has {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} until the gas disappears at the start of Coral's next turn.

bonus.name: Gift of Speech (1/Day)
entries: Coral targets one Beast she can see within 10 feet of herself. The target gains the ability to understand and speak Common or Sylvan (Coral's choice) for 10 minutes.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dandylion casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: The dandylion avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Tactique de groupe
entries: The dandylion avantage on an attack roll against une créature if at least one of the dandylion's allies is within 5 mètres of la créature and the ally doesn't have the {@conditionincapacité} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dandylion makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}13 ({@dégât 2d6 + 6}) piercingdgts.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}20 ({@dégât 4d6 + 6}) slashingdgts. Si  dandylion moved at least 20 mètres straight toward la cible immediately before thetouché, la cible doit réussir on a {@dd 17}Force saving throw or have the {@condition à terre} condition. If la cible has the {@condition à terre} condition, the dandylion can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Rejuvenating Seedpods (2/Day)
entries: The dandylion releases a burst of seedpods from its tail, filling a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature of the dandylion's choice in the sphere can immediately end one of the following conditions on itself (creature's choice): {@condition aveuglé}, {@condition sourd}, {@condition paralisé}, or {@condition empoisonné}. In addition, all soil in the sphere's area is enriched, restoring withered vegetation in the area to full health and causing all crops in the area to produce twice the normal harvest for the next year.

reaction.name: Roar of Pride
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the dandylion hits it with an attack roll, the dandylion can unleash a furious roar. The creature that triggered this reaction must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition frightened} condition until the end of the dandylion's next turn.

trait.name: Fiery Wings
entries: Rain's wings are made of flame, and they shed bright light out to 15 mètres and dim light for an additional 15 mètres. At the start of each of Rain's turns, each creature of Rain's choice within 5 mètres of her takes 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) firedgts. A creature thattouchés Rain with a melee attack takes 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) firedgts.

trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: Rain avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Rain makes two Hoof attacks.

action.name: Hoof
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}5 ({@dégât 2d4}) bludgeoningdgts.

action.name: Haloed Horn Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: Rain uses her haloed horn to produce one of the following magical effects:

action.name: Glitterstorm
entries: Rain emits a rainbow beam in a 30-foot line that is 5 mètres wide. Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 15}Dextérité saving throw, taking 21 ({@dégât 6d6}) radiantdgts on a failed saving throw, or half as muchdgts on a successful one; creatures of evil alignment have disadvantage on this saving throw. Si dgts from this effect reduces une créature to 0touché points, la créature dies, and its body turns into glittery flowers.

action.name: Healing Rainbows
entries: Rain releases a wave of rejuvenating multicolored light in a 30-foot cone. Each creature of Rain's choice in that area regains 18 ({@dice 4d8})touché points.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: Rain takes either the {@action Disengage} or the {@action Hide} action.

monster.name: Scrapper
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Electrified Chassis
entries: A creature thattouchés the scrapper with a melee attack while within 5 mètres of it takes 19 ({@dégât 3d12}) lightningdgts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scrapper makes two Spike Punch attacks. It can replace one of those with a Wires attack.

action.name: Spike Punch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}14 ({@dégât 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoningdgts plus 5 ({@dégât 1d10}) piercingdgts.

action.name: Wires
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 20 m,, one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target has the {@condition agrippé} condition (escape {@dd 16}) and doit réussir on a {@dd 16}Force saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 mètres of the scrapper and take 19 ({@dégât 3d12}) lightningdgts. The scrapper can have only une créature {@condition agrippé} in this way at a time.

action.name: Eye Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: The scrapper shoots a magical beam from its extended eye at une créature it can see within 120 mètres of itself. The target doit faire a {@dd 16}Dextérité saving throw, taking 44 ({@dégât 8d10}) forcedgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: Seth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Invisible in Water
entries: Seth has the {@condition invisible} condition while fully immersed in water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Seth makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}10 ({@dégât 1d6 + 7}) piercingdgts plus 9 ({@dégât 2d8}) colddgts.

action.name: Griffe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}14 ({@dégât 2d6 + 7}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Riptide Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Seth exhales a torrent of frigid water in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 16}jet de sauvegarde Constitution. On a failed save, la créature takes 36 ({@dégât 8d8}) colddgts and has the {@conditionincapacité} condition until la fin de son prochain tour. On a successful save, la créature takes half as muchdgts only.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Seth magically transforms into a Small Humanoid or a Beast that is Tiny or Small, while retaining his game statistics (other than his size). This transformation ends if Seth is reduced to 0 hit points or uses another bonus action to end it.

bonus.name: Superspeed (2/Day)
entries: Seth's speed is doubled for as long as he maintains {@status concentration} (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). While his speed is increased in this way, all attack rolls against him are made with disadvantage, and he becomes partially incorporeal, allowing him to move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. Seth takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: Sheldon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Space Dweller
entries: Sheldon can breathe normally in a vacuum.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sheldon makes either two Bite attacks, two Blueberry Fling attacks, or one of each.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d6 + 4}) piercingdgts plus 4 ({@dégât 1d8}) psychicdgts.

action.name: Blueberry Fling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, portée 30 m,, une créature. {@h}11 ({@dégât 2d6 + 4}) blueberrydgts.

action.name: Jetstream Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Sheldon exhales a line of magical wind that is 60 mètres long and 5 mètres wide. Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 15}Force saving throw. On a failed save, la créature takes 21 ({@dégât 6d6}) forcedgts, is pushed 15 mètres away from Sheldon, and has the {@condition à terre} condition. On a successful save, la créature takes half as muchdgts only.

bonus.name: Wind Dash (2/Day)
entries: Sheldon summons a powerful gust of wind and flies up to his speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. At the end of this movement, each creature within 5 feet of Sheldon must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition prone} condition, as the wind bursts around Sheldon.
